overview_description.description: Mobius Materials develops and supplies advanced silicon-based materials designed to improve performance and efficiency in energy storage and semiconductor applications. The company’s core technology focuses on producing high-purity silicon materials engineered for use in lithium-ion battery anodes, where they help increase energy density and extend battery life compared to conventional graphite-based solutions. Its materials are designed to integrate into existing battery manufacturing processes, supporting adoption without requiring major changes to production infrastructure. Mobius Materials also applies its silicon processing capabilities to specialty materials used in electronics and semiconductor manufacturing, addressing applications that require precise material properties and consistency. The company supports customers through material development, testing, and collaboration aimed at optimizing performance for specific use cases. Its offerings are used by organizations working on next-generation batteries and electronic components that require improved capacity, durability, and material efficiency.

product.name: Mobius Materials Electronic Components Marketplace
product.description: An online B2B marketplace for sourcing authenticated and tested electronic components from global inventory sellers.

identifier.value: Electronic Component Sourcing and RFQ Service

product.name: Electronic Component Sourcing and RFQ Service
product.description: A sourcing service that helps manufacturers procure individual components or complete bills of materials through market searches, RFQs, pricing comparisons, and supplier coordination.

product.name: Mobius E-Auction Marketplace
product.description: An auction-based marketplace that allows manufacturers to list excess electronic components and receive, compare, and negotiate competitive bids from qualified buyers.

product.name: Excess Inventory Valuation and Appraisal
product.description: An inventory valuation service that assesses electronic component stock and provides an estimated sale value based on available spot-market pricing.

identifier.value: Contract Manufacturing and Rapid Prototyping Services

product.name: Contract Manufacturing and Rapid Prototyping Services
product.description: Contract manufacturing support using facilities in Canada, Hong Kong, and the United States for rapid prototyping alongside component sourcing and authentication.

identifier.value: Electronic Component Inventory Sales and Fulfillment Service

product.name: Electronic Component Inventory Sales and Fulfillment Service
product.description: A managed resale service for surplus electronic components that coordinates buyer validation, authentication, export compliance, shipping, inspection, and payment.
